item.title: DevMemory: A Structured Memory Management Architecture for Persistent Knowledge in AI Coding Agents
item.description: AI coding agents operate without persistent memory; useful outputs produced in one session are unavailable in the next, and information from one project never transfers to another. We present DevMemory, a structured memory management architecture that brings trust-scored, cross-scope knowledge retrieval to AI coding agents.
